items.title: Lisa Allen, Chief Executive Officer
items.description: Lisa Allen provides strategic direction and leadership for the company's business objectives. Her role centers on guiding the vision, encouraging innovation, and keeping the focus on technology that creates meaningful value for clients.

items.title: Daniel Reeves, Chief Operating Officer
items.description: Daniel Reeves keeps daily operations lined up with client commitments. He coordinates delivery, staffing, and the working rhythm so each engagement moves from agreement to a finished result with clear ownership.

items.title: Kevin Koskela, Chief Technology Officer
items.description: Kevin Koskela provides technical leadership for JUSASOL's development direction, including technology strategy, software architecture, and solutions that stay scalable and maintainable.

items.title: Rachel Moore, Project Manager
items.description: Rachel Moore plans and guides client work from the first conversation through delivery. She keeps scope, timeline, and communication clear so the team and the client stay aligned.

items.title: Dillon Oswalt, Technical Leader
items.description: Dillon Oswalt supports technical planning, development coordination, and implementation. His role turns technical requirements into practical development approaches, with attention to quality and collaboration.
